column3:
ci: retry live probes independently

Give Radio, NPR, and BBC playback checks separate two-attempt retry boundaries so one transient endpoint failure cannot consume another provider's retry.

Split the Wikidata smoke test into four exact probes with the same isolated retry policy, and lock both workflow contracts down with regression tests.

Co-authored-by: OpenAI ChatGPT <noreply@openai.com>

release: prepare 0.26.0

Advance the package version for the default-on, independently removable YouTube QR capability and its four release artifact combinations. Refresh the source-archive fallback with the ten commits preceding this release.

Co-authored-by: OpenAI ChatGPT <noreply@openai.com>

youtube: add selected-video QR codes

Encode the full canonical YouTube watch URL offline and render it in a scanner-safe modal reached through the Help-only Q shortcut. Keep the QR encoder behind an independent default-on Cargo feature and suppress the virtual TTY pointer while the symbol is visible.

Publish and validate all four image/QR binary combinations, report the compiled capability in diagnostics, and cover canonical URLs, modal input, small terminals, feature omission, and packaging with deterministic regressions.

Co-authored-by: OpenAI ChatGPT <noreply@openai.com>

release: prepare 0.25.0

Advance the package version for offline build history, runtime provenance, Local all-files browsing, safe text-editor handoff, and the accompanying TUI regressions. Refresh the source-archive fallback with the ten commits preceding this release.

Co-authored-by: OpenAI ChatGPT <noreply@openai.com>

local: show all files and open text documents

Add a Local-panel toggle that preserves selection while revealing regular non-media files. Classify text files conservatively, open them through the platform default association on desktops, and suspend the TUI for terminal editors with a Vim fallback on physical Linux consoles.

Keep special files and symbolic links excluded, and cover provider, controller, planner, and renderer behavior with mock-backed regressions.

Co-authored-by: OpenAI ChatGPT <noreply@openai.com>

history: cover popup rendering and navigation

Lock in full commit-message rendering, current-version highlighting, runtime provenance, scroll controls, and the help-only F9 shortcut.

Co-authored-by: OpenAI ChatGPT <noreply@openai.com>

history: add offline build and installation details

Embed the ten most recent commits at build time, expose them in a scrollable F9 popup, and enrich the view with executable, launch, package, and source provenance. When networking is available, compare once successfully with GitHub and cache newer commits in RAM while preserving the embedded offline view.

Teach release archives to retain enough Git metadata and record their GitHub-release origin.

Co-authored-by: OpenAI ChatGPT <noreply@openai.com>

tui: fix persistent control-state regressions

Keep subscription refresh contextual instead of duplicating it in the footer, make the comments scrollbar reach its final viewport, and remove the redundant playing marker from the seek status.

Co-authored-by: OpenAI ChatGPT <noreply@openai.com>
